newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bourse traded halted by technical problems.
newsitem.headline: French bourse traded halted by technical problems.

text.p: French stock trading was disrupted by technical communication problems on Monday afternoon, a spokesman for the French stockmarkets association SBF said.
He could not say when trade would resume. A special fixing was set last week when trade was halted for similar reasons.
The CAC-40 index was down 10.23 points, or 0.36 percent, at 2,798.29 when trade was disrupted.
